by
  intro x Hin
  induction post <;>
    simp [OldExpressions.substOld,
      Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at * <;> try simp_all
  case app fn e fn_ih e_ih =>
    split at Hin
    · split at Hin <;>
        simp_all [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
    · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
        Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at Hin
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
      cases fn_ih <;> simp_all
      cases e_ih <;> simp_all
  case quant k ty tr_ih e_ih =>
    cases Hin <;> simp_all
    cases tr_ih <;> simp_all
    cases e_ih <;> simp_all
  case ite c t e c_ih t_ih e_ih =>
    cases Hin with
    | inl Hin => cases c_ih <;> simp_all
    | inr Hin =>
      cases Hin with
      | inl Hin => cases t_ih <;> simp_all
      | inr Hin => cases e_ih <;> simp_all
  case eq e1 e2 e1_ih e2_ih =>
    cases Hin <;> simp_all
    cases e1_ih <;> simp_all
    cases e2_ih <;> simp_all
